learning.subject: — subject: I, you, he, she, we, they
learning.formulas: Read from left to right, then add the remaining words. Present Simple: use V-s (-s / -es) or does with he / she / it; use V1 or do with other subjects. Present Perfect: he / she / it takes has; others take have. Continuous: I takes am; he / she / it takes is; you / we / they take are. In the past: I / he / she / it takes was; you / we / they take were.
learning.simpleRules: After do / does / did, always use the base verb V1. These Simple formulas apply to ordinary verbs; to be and modal verbs follow separate rules.
learning.mapCaption: The examples use work. Some forms, especially Future Perfect Continuous, are uncommon: choose the form that fits the context.
learning.simpleNote: The drill table covers the three Simple tenses. To be and modal verbs follow separate rules.
learning.perfectNote: Present Perfect: have/has + V3. Already and yet are clues, not required markers.
